_about: Kirsopp Lake’s footnotes to his Greek text (m Codex Mosquensis; b Baroccianus; p Parisinus; s Hierosolymitanus; v Vindobonensis; E Eusebius; L the Latin version), and in "refs" the passages of Scripture he prints in the margin (with the digital file’s own reference, "urn"). The digital file has only the Greek pages, so the footnotes Lake prints under his English translation on the facing pages are not here. "at" is the verse the note or reference stands in ("title": the title above the greeting). Greek inside a note is in Beta Code, as in the digital file (so h(mw=n = ἡμῶν), and the file has slips in the notes’ English and Greek. From First1KGreek (Open Greek and Latin), CC BY-SA 4.0.
